Name: hotter Mr. Qi Portraits and Sprites
Author: therealLiranea
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51467/51467-1793529669-1472589194.png[/img][/center]
[center][color=#d4d4d8]A merge of two awesome mods from which a younger, hotter and more sly version of Mr. Qi emerged.[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]I stumbled upon the anime-style portraits published by Mmabc623 a while ago and they pretty much captured the vibe I always had in mind for Mr. Qi. But since my in-game art style is more vanilla style, I had to adapt the portraits a bit. 
[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]While looking for an inspiration or a good reference, I came across the perfect base provided by none other than Poltergeister ( kudos, to you - great work as usual! ) I basically just edited the portraits of Aymeric and added a bit more shadows, glasses and the stars according to the anime portraits. The hat was a problem hahaha, but SliimeScholar created a perfect reference within the stunning Ripley mod, so Mr. Qi finally lost the pointy hat and gained a more fedora-ish hat. [/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b]Anyway. I hereby give you my take and merge of Mr. Qi. Enjoy :) [/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]If you use other replacer bundle mods, be sure to uncheck Mr. Qi in them, so this mod works properly.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][u]Future development ideas: [/u][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]- if possible blinking stars around the sprites... [/center]
[center]- tilesheet replacer for Mr. Qi inside of the airplane :D [/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51467/51467-1793530505-1673479196.png[/img][/center]
[center][color=#d4d4d8]Drumrolls...since this, for once, is not an art replacer : j[/color]ust download and extract the mod files into the Stardew Valley mods folder.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Default path when using Steam:  C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\mods[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]If you run into any kind of problems, be sure to report them to me :) [/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51467/51467-1793530842-1531185259.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]None, but you should definitely check out the original mods linked at the end of this page.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51467/51467-1793531030-762753756.png[/img][/center]
[center]Chapeau to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39809]MrQi -- style Friendable Mr.Qi Portraits[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Mmabc623?gameId=1303]Mmabc623[/url] and thanks for the permission. [/center]
[center]Also like usually a big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister?gameId=1303]Poltergeister[/url] and their incredible [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24347]Slightly Cuter Aymeric[/url] <3 [/center]
[center]And a special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/SliimeScholar?gameId=1303]SliimeScholar[/url] and their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32660]Ripley the Farmer Mod[/url] from which I used ( with permission, ofc ) the hat! :) [/center]
